channel.title: Football's Greatest Bears News
channel.description: Original FGB-written Chicago Bears news briefs with source attribution for Football's Greatest Bears live programming.

item.title: Bagent gets the preseason start while key Bears starters sit
item.description: FGB brief: Tyson Bagent will open Saturday's preseason game at quarterback as Chicago rests Caleb Williams and several other first-team players.

item.title: Bears leadership says Hammond is now the stadium focus
item.description: FGB brief: George McCaskey and Kevin Warren say planning resources are centered on Hammond, Indiana, while the franchise would keep the Chicago Bears name wherever the stadium is built.

item.title: Bears host Browns Saturday in their 2026 preseason opener
item.description: FGB brief: Chicago opens the preseason at Soldier Field against Cleveland at noon Central, with the Bears Network carrying the game locally.

item.title: Optimistic Bears outlook hinges on health, young weapons and a Caleb leap
item.description: FGB opinion brief: One upbeat 2026 scenario has Chicago contending if the roster stabilizes physically, its young pass catchers break out, the defense improves and Caleb Williams reaches another level.

item.title: Opinion: Bears stadium push renews debate over teams leaving city centers
item.description: FGB opinion brief: The Bears' focus on Hammond is feeding a broader argument about whether new stadium economics are pulling historic NFL franchises away from the urban fan bases that built them.
